wuduSteps.title: Niyyah & Bismillah
wuduSteps.desc: Make the intention in your heart to perform Wudu purely for the sake of Allah, and say “Bismillah”.

wuduSteps.title: Wash Hands
wuduSteps.desc: Wash both hands up to the wrists three times, ensuring water reaches between the fingers.

wuduSteps.title: Rinse Mouth
wuduSteps.desc: Take water into the mouth and rinse thoroughly three times (Madmadah).

wuduSteps.title: Rinse Nose
wuduSteps.desc: Sniff water gently into the nostrils and blow it out, three times (Istinshaq).

wuduSteps.title: Wash Face
wuduSteps.desc: Wash the face from forehead to chin and ear to ear, three times.

wuduSteps.title: Wash Arms
wuduSteps.desc: Wash the right arm then the left arm up to and including the elbows, three times each.

wuduSteps.title: Wipe Head & Ears
wuduSteps.desc: Wipe the head once with wet hands, then wipe the inside and outside of both ears.

wuduSteps.title: Wash Feet
wuduSteps.desc: Wash the right foot then the left foot up to and including the ankles, three times each.
